column1: # Where each skill's example file lives in a project, and how audit.sh compares it.
#   logic    behaviour or security rules that should stay as in the example — any drift is reviewed
#   design   adapted to the site's design and content — drift is expected; review the contract
#   snippet  merged into a larger project file — not diffed; review that the snippet is present
#   variant  one of several alternatives (menu profiles) — not diffed
